name: バースト性検出
description: 分析します the バースト性 パターンテキスト内の to distinguish AI生成の from 人間が書いた content.
useCase: Detecting AI text through 分析 of 文の長さ and complexity variation
mechanism: 測定します the variation (バースト性) in sentence structures, lengths, and complexity throughout a text. Human writing naturally varies 間の simple and complex sentences, short and long paragraphs. AI生成の text tends to maintain a more uniform level of complexity, resulting in lower バースト性 scores.
source: Guo et al. (2023) - How Close is ChatGPT to Human Experts? Comparison Corpus, Evaluation, and Detection, arXiv
algorithm: Sentence Length Variance + Structural Complexity Scoring + Moving Window Analysis
parameters: ウィンドウサイズ: 5 sentences, Metrics: length 分散, complexity index, transition エントロピー
strengths:
• シンプルで解釈しやすい指標
• ある程度言語に依存しない
• 他のテキスト手法との組み合わせで良好に動作
• 任意の長さのテキストで高速計算
limitations:
• Lower 精度 as standalone detector
• Academic and technical writing naturally has low バースト性
• AI models are improving at mimicking human variability
• Very short texts are unreliable

references.title: Guo, B. et al. (2023). How Close is ChatGPT to Human Experts? arXiv.
Mitchell, E. et al. (2023). DetectGPT: Zero-Shot Machine-Generated Text Detection using Probability Curvature. ICML.
Tulchinskii, E. et al. (2024). Intrinsic Dimension Estimation for Robust Detection of AI-Generated Texts. NeurIPS.
